exceptions.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-05. eslint-config-next@16.2.11 still installs eslint-import-resolver-typescript@3.10.1 (published 2025-04-21). That version has no npm provenance attestation (registry attestations 404). Latest 4.4.5 (published 2026-06-01) does have SLSA provenance, but this lockfile does not select it. pnpm trustPolicy no-downgrade rejects 3.10.1 as a high-risk trust downgrade. npm advisory bulk lookup returned no advisories for 3.10.1. The package is still required by eslint-config-next.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when eslint-config-next resolves a release with provenance, such as 4.4.5 or newer, and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile passes with trustPolicy no-downgrade and this exclude removed.

exceptions.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-05. semver@7.8.5 (published 2026-06-19) has npm provenance and was not flagged. semver@6.3.1 (published 2023-07-10) has no provenance attestation and is still pulled by @babel/core@7.29.7, eslint-plugin-import@2.32.0, and eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5. pnpm trustPolicy no-downgrade rejects only semver@6.3.1 as a high-risk trust downgrade. npm advisory bulk lookup returned no advisories for 6.3.1 or 7.8.5. The exclude is package-wide because pnpm trustPolicyExclude does not take a version.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when the lockfile no longer contains semver@6.3.1, or when that release gains provenance, and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile passes with trustPolicy no-downgrade and this exclude removed.

exceptions.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-06. braces@3.0.3 (published 2024-05-21) is the latest npm release; 3.0.4 is listed as the patched version and is not published. pnpm why braces shows only devDependencies: eslint-config-next@16.3.8 > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch > braces, and react-doctor@0.7.6 > deslop-js > fast-glob > micromatch > braces. No app, worker, or content file imports braces, micromatch, or fast-glob. The advisory is stack exhaustion while expanding a deeply nested brace pattern, which these tools do not accept from site visitors. pnpm audit --prod does not report this GHSA. Other high and critical findings found the same day (source-map-js, proxy-addr, compression) were overridden to published patches instead of ignored.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when npm publishes braces >=3.0.4 and the lockfile resolves it, or when eslint-config-next and react-doctor no longer depend on braces, and GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm is absent from pnpm audit --json.
